words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}) opens the ayah as a ratified verdict, not as a neutral label or a loose attention marker. It governs {{ar:ٱلْأَبْرَارَ}} ({{tr:al-abrāra}}) and scopes forward to the predicate {{ar:لَفِى نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:la-fī naʿīmin}}), so the class and its bliss-state are held inside one asserted construction. The doubled nūn gives the opening confirmation audible weight, and the later {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) carries that certainty into the predicate rather than leaving emphasis only at the start. After the witnessed-record scene (83:21), this particle turns evidentiary pressure into a stated outcome.

topics.reason: The opening particle bears emphatic form, and the input separately marks {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) as predicate emphasis, supporting a two-point assertion pattern.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَبْرَارَ}} ({{tr:al-abrāra}}) names a definite moral cohort, not an abstract virtue and not a scattered set of good acts. Its accusative case comes from {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}), so the word remains the semantic subject that bears the state of {{ar:لَفِى نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:la-fī naʿīmin}}) rather than becoming an object. The {{ar:ب ر ر}} ({{tr:b-r-r}}) field is narrowed here to fulfilled righteousness, truthfulness, and dutiful beneficence; concrete branches such as land or grain are blocked by the human plural class form. The article and case also reconnect the class to the record phrase in 83:18, moving the same group from written status to lived bliss, while the boundary from 83:21 shifts from honored witnesses to the certified class whose verdict follows. The formula recalls 82:13 and makes the b-r-r class the paired counterpart to n-ʿ-m bliss, while birr-testing passages (2:177; 3:92) supply the moral depth behind the class name.

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) does not govern {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) the way a genitive preposition would; it strengthens the predicate phrase that follows. Its force lands on the claim that the righteous are truly in bliss, not merely on the subject noun, and it marks the hinge where the clause turns from the named righteous class into predicate-space. Because it is fused on the surface with {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), {{ar:لَفِى}} ({{tr:la-fī}}) makes assertion and containment arrive in one predicate onset, completing the emphasis begun by {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}). The long ī that begins in {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) also lets the secured predicate stretch toward the final bliss word.

topics.headline: fused predicate onset

topics.reason: The input treats {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) as a split segment from the surface bundle {{ar:لَفِى}} ({{tr:la-fī}}), so the fusion is visible while the particle roles remain distinct.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) is the particle that actually governs {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) and supplies the clause's predicate relation. It makes bliss the domain in which the righteous are situated, not an object handed to them or a detachable setting added after a complete sentence. With an abstract noun, its containment force becomes a state-domain relation: the bliss is inhabited like an environment. Coming after the confirmed subject, the prepositional predicate gives the clause its delayed landing. Even within the compact surface {{ar:لَفِى}} ({{tr:la-fī}}), {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) retains this governing role while carrying the fused emphatic onset toward the final noun.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence state that {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) and forms the predicate of the {{tr:ʾinna}} clause.

words.prose: {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) closes the ayah as the domain that the predicate has been building toward. Its genitive case comes from {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so bliss is not a transferred object or owned item but the environment in which the righteous are situated. The indefinite singular form keeps the bliss qualitatively open and immeasurable, especially against the definite class {{ar:ٱلْأَبْرَارَ}} ({{tr:al-abrāra}}). Within the {{ar:ن ع م}} ({{tr:n-ʿ-m}}) family, the local word selects blissful ease and pleasant well-being; bestowal, softness, enjoyment, and abundance enrich that state, while livestock, ostrich, affirmation, and other branches do not become the local meaning. After the attested record scene, the noun completes the move into an inhabited domain and forms a local thread: 83:22 names the domain, and 83:24 makes that bliss visible as radiance. It recalls the formula at 82:13, pairs n-ʿ-m bliss with the moral class, and contrasts with accountable favor at 102:8, while its final long ī and nasal close let the emphatic clause settle into ease.

topics.headline: governed domain, not object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bliss is the state-domain occupied by the righteous, not a detachable reward object handed over in the sentence.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) as genitive under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), completing the prepositional predicate rather than functioning as a direct object.

topics.headline: indefinite open bliss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral class is definite while the bliss remains unmeasured and qualitatively expansive.
topics.reason: The local noun is indefinite singular with tanwīn, while {{ar:ٱلْأَبْرَارَ}} ({{tr:al-abrāra}}) is definite, allowing the class to be fixed and the bliss-domain to remain open-ended.

topics.headline: root-family bliss-ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local word concentrates ease, favor, softness, enjoyment, and abundance into lived bliss while wider root branches are kept outside the selected sense.
topics.reason: V4 lists many {{ar:ن ع م}} ({{tr:n-ʿ-m}}) branches, but the local gerund under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) selects the bliss/ease and pleasant well-being branch; bestowal and softness remain positive lexical pressure, while livestock, ostrich, affirmation, and other branches are not locally activated.

topics.headline: state form over counted favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chosen noun names the bliss-state itself rather than describing the righteous with an adjective or listing a countable favor.
topics.reason: The local gerund/abstract noun fits the predicate domain, while alternative family forms such as an adjective of softness or a countable favor noun would shift the construction's focus.

topics.headline: local visible thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bliss named as a domain here (83:22) becomes visible as radiance two ayahs later (83:24).
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows explicitly connect indefinite {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) in 83:22 with the later definite reprise and visible radiance phrase in 83:24.

topics.headline: formula and accountability contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same bliss word participates in a secured verdict formula (82:13) while contrasting with questioned favor (102:8).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete references: 82:13 supplies the exact verdict formula, and 102:8 contrasts favor under questioning with bliss as secured domain.

topics.headline: verdict pair with abrār
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bliss is the formulaic counterpart to the righteous class rather than isolated reward vocabulary.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL co-occurrence row links {{ar:ن ع م}} ({{tr:n-ʿ-m}}) with {{ar:ب ر ر}} ({{tr:b-r-r}}) through the abrār verdict formula.

topics.headline: closure and sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is where the clause lands, with sound and position softening stacked emphasis into settled bliss.
topics.reason: The noun stands at ayah closure after the emphatic and prepositional build-up, and the phonetic rows describe long ī plus final nasal release.

topics.reason: The boundary rows frame {{ar:نَعِيمٍ}} ({{tr:naʿīmin}}) as the state replacing the prior document-and-witness scene and connecting forward to visible radiance (83:24).

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Expansive right action opens into bestowed well-being.** `ب ر ر` B002 supplies expansive righteousness and obedience; `ن ع م` B001 supplies pleasant well-being, favor, and bounty. The repeated `لَفِى` echoes the two record-locations, but the container is now experienced condition rather than archive. I assign righteousness the role of an outwardly expansive practice and favor the role of its surrounding return. The inferred arrow is not mechanical purchase but fitting correspondence: non-deficient giving is answered by non-deficient good. The ayah reads as a moral ecology of abundance.

2. **Ease reverses the strain of competitive extraction.** `ن ع م` B002 supplies softness and easeful living. The earlier offenders strain to secure fullness from others, whereas 83:25–28 depicts recipients being given drink from a prepared source. I infer that genuine ease is received within a just order rather than seized through asymmetry. The ayah thus critiques the counterfeit security of extraction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The sealed drink, aromatic finish, elevated mixture, and spring in 83:25–28 filled `نَعِيم` with a coherent provision-chain rather than leaving it as an abstract condition.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Deeds that hold under record become a held condition.** Lexical evidence: ب ر ر/B001, "truth that makes word or deed hold," in ٱلْأَبْرَارَ, and ن ع م/B001, "pleasant well-being and bestowed favor," in نَعِيمٍ. Structural cue: marked registration and knowledgeable witness occupy 83:18-21, after which لَفِى locates the righteous inside favor. Assigned role: B001 describes conduct that survives verification; favor is the stable allocation attached to it. Abductive move: I infer that the record and witnesses test whether deeds "hold," then the prepositional enclosure realizes the result. Reading change: ٱلْأَبْرَارَ are those whose truth remains sound under audit, and نَعِيمٍ is the condition their soundness can sustain.

2. **Expansive good unfolds into a multi-sensory bounty.** Lexical evidence: ب ر ر/B002, "expansive righteousness and obedience," and ن ع م/B001. Structural cue: the compressed statement expands through couch and sight (83:23), facial freshness (83:24), pure sealed drink (83:25), musk (83:26), and elevated mixture (83:27). Assigned role: B002 supplies outward moral breadth; B001 supplies the correspondingly broad field of benefit. Abductive move: I infer that the later sensory sequence unpacks rather than merely accompanies نَعِيمٍ. Reading change: bliss reads as a coordinated environment of access, perception, nourishment, and fragrance, not an undifferentiated pleasant feeling.

3. **Ease is protected rather than inert.** Lexical evidence: ن ع م/B002, "softness and easeful living," in نَعِيمٍ. Structural cue: couches at 83:23 and served drink at 83:25 give ease bodily form, while the seal and musk at 83:25-26 secure its quality. Assigned role: B002 supplies repose; sealing prevents that repose from meaning vulnerability or decay. Abductive move: I infer that sealed purity is the protection mechanism of ease. Reading change: نَعِيمٍ is soft living with integrity preserved, not mere passivity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The mixture from an elevated source at 83:27 completed the later unpacking of نَعِيمٍ: bliss includes not only repose and sensory pleasure but traceable composition and provenance. This strengthened ب ر ر/B002 as expansive good whose outcome extends across environment, body, and supply.
